new_scholarship.description: PRONABEC, Peru's national scholarship and student credit agency, has opened an extraordinary 2026 call offering 20 complete scholarships for Peruvian professionals who hold a master's or doctoral degree abroad. new_scholarship.description: The Banco de la República sponsors postgraduate study at foreign institutions of recognised academic excellence for Colombian professionals, and the programme is organised by discipline rather than as one open call. The lines named on the official programme page are doctoral study in economics, master's degrees in public administration and public policy, a postgraduate qualification in economic law, and patronage of individual young talent in plastic arts and in music. new_scholarship.official_source: Escuela Doctoral Franco-Peruana en Ciencias de la Ingeniería y Geociencias (EDFPCIG), administrada por la Escuela de Posgrado de la PUCP
new_scholarship.description: The Escuela Doctoral Franco-Peruana en Ciencias de la Ingeniería y Geociencias (EDFPCIG) is a joint Peruvian-French doctoral training structure funded by its members, the French Embassy in Peru, the Institut de recherche pour le développement (IRD) and the Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú. For the 2026 call it awards a single doctoral scholarship for a Peruvian candidate to complete a three-year full-time doctorate in geosciences, energy, the environment or related fields, spending year one and year three at PUCP and a one-year research stay in France in year two. The award is a living stipend for accommodation, food and local mobility totalling EUR 39,576 over the 36 months, with non-monetary benefits detailed in the bases. Two supervision modalities are offered: co-tutelage, which leads to a PUCP doctorate and a French Doctorat through a joint agreement, or co-direction, where the student is enrolled only at PUCP.
new_scholarship.duration: Three years (36 months): year 1 doctoral thesis at PUCP, year 2 one-year research stay at a French partner university of the IRD joint unit, year 3 doctoral thesis at PUCP
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Peruvian nationals under 40 years of age at the close of applications, holding a master's degree awarded by a Peruvian or foreign higher-education institution properly registered with SUNEDU, in a field covered by the EDFPCIG, and filing the full mandatory documentation.

new_scholarship.name: Becas Colombia Biodiversa - Fondo de Becas Colombia Biodiversa, Convocatoria II-2026
new_scholarship.description: The Colombia Biodiversa scholarship fund of the Fundación Alejandro Ángel Escobar supports undergraduate and master's thesis research on the knowledge, conservation or sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity, from any area of knowledge. For its II-2026 call the foundation awards grants of up to three million five hundred thousand Colombian pesos per grantee, and the money may be used for equipment, which then belongs to the student. Only Colombian students enrolled at a recognised Colombian university or a formally recognised foreign university may apply, and the thesis must already be approved and be at the start or early stage of execution. One grantee in this call is additionally offered a placement at the AKAE Conservación reserve in the Colombian Orinoquía, covering field research, land and sea transport to the reserve, and accommodation and food on site.

new_scholarship.selection_notes: Candidates are scored on a 0 to 20 scale by the doctoral programme's own Directing Committee against four criteria: the doctoral research project, academic and research experience, the motivation letter, and the recommendation letters. A score of 18 or higher (90th percentile) is required to reach the selection stage. Selection is then made by the VRI on the strength of the final merit ranking, in two rounds: one grant for the best-ranked candidate of each doctoral programme that has eligible candidates, then the second-ranked candidates up to a maximum of two grantees per doctoral programme. Results are final and not appealable.

Applicants who have not graduated from PUCP receive differentiated registration-fee discounts between 10 August and 18 September and between 19 September and 12 October.
